text:
maria: Noticing a surge of NotReady nodes in eu-west1 after the BMC/BIOS maintenance at 02:55Z. Pods are getting evicted and inference tail latency is spiking.

jonathan: Dashboard shows ~12 GPUs across 4 hosts drained. Scheduler moved jobs to best-effort pools.

sre-robin: Quick look: out-of-band logs show repeated "AER: Uncorrected error" and subsequent nvme controller resets on slot 2. Seems correlated with secure-boot flag flip on a subset of BMC images.

infra-oncall: Can confirm. r09-{02..05} show PCIe link retrain events at 02:58Z-03:04Z. Local flash can reproduce on a single rack canary with the same image.

maria: Please hold the global rollout. We haven't pushed to us-west or ap-northeast yet.

deploy-bot: rollout "bmc-bios/2026-03-21" status: PAUSED by infra-oncall at 03:12Z

aisha: +1 pause. Proposed mitigation: revert BMC on affected racks to previous signed image and run a 45m read-only canary (storage I/O + long-lived GPU allocation).

ops-ethan: I'm starting revert on r09-02. Command I'm using:
```
ssh jump-rack-ops
sudo bmc-fw-tool flash --image s3://fw-repo/bmc-2026-02-07-signed.bin --rack r09-02 --force-reboot
sleep 30 && bmc-health --rack r09-02 --json | jq '.links, .nvme.status'
```

jonathan: Also check BMC time sync (PTP/NTP). If BMCs are >1s skew we saw signatures get rejected and partial feature toggles can happen.

infra-oncall: bmcctl ntp-check r09-02..05 -> offsets: 1.7s, 0.4s, 2.2s, 1.1s. Forcing ntp update on the ones >1s before reflashing.

sre-robin: Short-term cluster tweak: increase kubelet eviction grace to 8m and disable aggressive node autoscaler scale-in for eu-west1 inference pools to avoid cascading reschedules.

maria: Good. Ops, after revert, please run 30m fio against local nvme + a 10m GPU burn to ensure device retention under load.

ops-ethan: Running stress now on r09-02. Early logs look better: no immediate AER after revert. Will watch nvme SMART:
`smartctl -a /dev/nvme0n1 | egrep -i "critical|error|temperature"`

finance-liz: Heads-up: if we hold autoscaler/evictions and keep canaries for 24-48h this will add ~90-150 GPU-hours in eu-west1. Alerted budget owners.

jonathan: If revert is green on r09-02, propose resuming rollout with 1-rack canary and increasing the observation window to 60m and enabling full PCIe telemetry logging.

aisha: Agreed. Also add a pre-check script to the deploy pipeline that validates BMC time, PCIe AER counters, and NVMe reset counts before allowing a rack-level apply.

maria: Postmortem owners: jonathan + aisha. Immediate action list: pause rollout (done), revert affected racks (in progress), autoscaler hold (done), finance ping (done). Will update #incidents in 20m. :thumbsup:
